name: Titans of Time
storyline: The King has mysteriously fallen ill, leaving the Hand of the King to rule in his place. Obsessed with the legend of the Amulets of Ascension, the Hand discovers that the ancient legend is real as evil begins to spread throughout the realm. As an ancient champion, the player must rise to confront the growing threat, explore the realm, and ultimately decide whether they can save it from the forces of evil.
summary:
Titans of Time is a free-to-play 3D fantasy MMORPG played in a web browser. Players choose from five classes - Assassin, Priest, Titan, Philosopher and Druid - and develop their characters through customizable stats, class talent trees, equipment and progression for hundreds of levels!

Players explore a large world and its darker counterpart, complete quests, conquer temples and battle world bosses. Multiplayer features include parties, guilds called Legions with shared vaults and customizable ranks, duels and optional open-world PvP. Other activities include sailing and naval combat, fishing, cooking, herbalism and alchemy. Players can collect mounts, recruit combat pets and enhance equipment with socketed gems.
